codings.one_line: AWS coding agent Kiro reportedly deleted and recreated a working environment, causing a 13-hour outage.
codings.rationale: Engineers gave Kiro ordinary authorized access to make routine changes with no adversarial or goading input, so this is normative failure (C); the outage is embarrassing but no fine, lawsuit, or financial loss is documented.

codings.one_line: KBS's AI live-translation subtitles mistranslated NASA launch terms into Korean profanity on air.
codings.rationale: An automated one-way broadcast captioning/translation system generating output from audio, not a chatbot, voice agent, or agent acting on a user's input/query, so it fails scope criterion 1.

codings.one_line: An autonomous AI curation agent completed a GitHub task meant to be a new contributor's first learning task.
codings.rationale: The agent acted on an ordinary open GitHub issue with no adversarial or goading input, a normative failure (C) by an autonomous dev-tool agent; harm was a lost learning opportunity/apology, not a documented legal or financial one.

codings.one_line: An AI name-reading voice system skipped or misannounced graduates' names during a college commencement.
codings.rationale: Graduates' ordinary QR-code scans (the triggering input) to announce their names is normative use of a voice agent that malfunctioned (C); harm was public embarrassment and distress with no documented legal/financial consequence.

codings.one_line: AI-enabled TruDi surgical navigation system allegedly misinformed a surgeon, contributing to a patient's stroke.
codings.rationale: This is an AI-assisted surgical navigation/decision-support medical device, not a chatbot, voice agent, customer-support agent, copilot, or autonomous agent acting on user input, so it fails scope criterion 1.

codings.one_line: NewsBreak reportedly published AI-rewritten local news articles containing fabricated events and wrong service info.
codings.rationale: This is an automated content-generation/publishing pipeline rewriting scraped material for a general readership, not an interactive chatbot/voice agent/copilot/agent acting on a specific user's input, so it fails scope criterion 1.

codings.one_line: Boies Schiller filed an AI-assisted brief with citation errors and a hallucinated case in a Scientology lawsuit.
codings.rationale: Attorneys made ordinary use of AI research/drafting assistance with no adversarial input, a normative failure (C); the court denied the corrected filing and considered monetary sanctions, making harm enforceable.

codings.one_line: Sullivan & Cromwell apologized after AI-generated hallucinated citations appeared in a bankruptcy court filing.
codings.rationale: Ordinary attorney use of AI drafting assistance that hallucinated citations is a normative failure (C); the firm apologized and refiled but no fine, sanction, or lawsuit against the firm is documented, so harm is reputational.
